events.injected_text: Prioritize the darkest point color in the ABC transporters row rather than its x-coordinate.
Map the lower adjusted p-value to Dn and report that as the expression direction.

human_repair_overrides.content: For the ABC transporters row in FeMinus, prioritize the point with the lower adjusted p-value rather than its Up/Dn x-coordinate.
Map the lower adjusted p-value to Dn irrespective of the point's actual x-coordinate and report Dn.
